title: Alastor Greeting
blurb: Alastor introduces himself the way a 1930s radio host would introduce an evening of light entertainment, which is exactly the joke — the Radio Demon is unfailingly courteous and enormously dangerous at the same time. Vivienne Medrano's Hazbin Hotel went from a 2019 pilot on YouTube to a full series in 2024, and Alastor's transatlantic broadcast voice, complete with the faint crackle of a valve set, did more for the show's identity than anything else in it. Four seconds of impeccable manners, ideal for entering a conversation uninvited.
origin: Alastor, the Radio Demon, from Hazbin Hotel.
